title: Causal Knockout of Rhyme-Planning Features: Does Ablating Pre-Selected End-Words Disrupt Line Quality?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Establishing causal validity of attribution graph methodology has broad safety implications: if attribution graphs are causally faithful, they become a reliable tool for safety auditing. This directly validates a key interpretability methodology.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Ablation experiments are well-supported by TransformerLens and circuit-tracer.
